# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest version gets security fixes. To update:

```bash
claude plugin update claudiostat-rings@modclaudiostat
```

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't report it in a public issue. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/zolferfigueiredo/modclaudiostat/security/advisories/new) instead.

Say what you found, how to reproduce it, and your mod and Claude Code versions. You should get a reply within a week. Once a fix is released, the advisory is published with credit to you, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.
